findings.claim: 未找到通路或商業模式的正式轉變；可查到的是安裝基礎管理（IBM，服務與現場選配）營收在 2026 Q2 約 28 億歐元，高於指引約 3 億歐元，主要來自升級業務，管理層預期 2026 年 IBM 成長逾 30%。
findings.excerpt: Installed Base Management sales for the quarter came in at 2.8 billion euros, almost 300 million euros above our guidance, a result driven primarily by additional upgrade business.

findings.claim: IBM 預期 2026 年成長逾 30%，驅動來自擴大中的 EUV 安裝基礎之服務營收與客戶對效能／產能升級的需求。
findings.excerpt: Installed Base Management sales are expected to grow more than 30%, driven by service revenue from the expanding EUV installed base and customer demand for performance and productivity upgrades.
